subject: RE: Re: PO PO-E002-0012 - delay??
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Sorry for delay, our transporter had strike in Pune since Friday and truck could not move. Truck is loaded now and left tonite. Will reach by Thursday for sure. Only 350 pcs of PL-01 can be sent in this lot, remaining we are short of raw material (fish meal supplier problem). Pls bear with us.

Thanks & regards
Rakesh Shah
Purrline Nutrition LLP
